name: io.github.vish288/mcp-coda
description: Coda MCP server (MCP 2026-07-28): docs, pages, tables, rows, automations; writes or read-only

environmentVariables.name: CODA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Coda API token (also accepts CODA_TOKEN or CODA_PAT)

environmentVariables.name: CODA_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Alias for MCP_READ_ONLY. Any value other than false/0/no/off/empty locks the server read-only; --read-only can only raise the lock

environmentVariables.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Locks the server read-only: write tools and write-workflow prompts are not listed and nothing lifts the lock at runtime. Shared name across the mcp-* servers; set it in the deployer's env

environmentVariables.name: CODA_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token (min 16 chars) required to bind an HTTP transport to a non-loopback host; clients send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
